selection: From sealed-01, choose the largest 54-DoF max-tip residual with a zero radial lower bound and the largest with a positive radial lower bound, restricted to witnesses within 10 micrometres of the collision margin. Break ties by case_key.
comparison: Reoptimize with the same three recorded input initializations and the frozen objective, joint ranges, J6/J7 constraints and budget. Compare clearance 0.5 mm versus zero margin without model penetration.
scope: Retrospective limited counterfactual only. Use no new dataset or model. Do not update the mapped or feasible score target.
